title: The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI
explain_beginner: Nearly 40 percent of American adults now use generative AI in their daily lives. In workplaces, about one in four employees have tried it recently, with some using it daily. Generative AI is spreading faster than personal computers and the internet did when they first launched. Workers report that this technology helps them save time on tasks, suggesting it could significantly boost how much people accomplish at work.
explain_business: Generative AI is being adopted by American workers at historically rapid rates, comparable to personal computers. Roughly one in four employees currently use it for work, driven significantly by organizational policies. With technology assisting between 1 and 5 percent of work hours and employees reporting meaningful time savings, companies face clear incentives to implement and support generative AI adoption. Organizations that establish favorable policies and integrate these tools strategically may capture substantial productivity advantages.
explain_practitioner: National surveys tracked generative AI adoption across the US adult population through late 2024. The study found that 40 percent of adults age 18-64 use generative AI broadly, while 23 percent of employed respondents used it for work within the previous week and 9 percent used it daily. Work adoption velocity matches early personal computer adoption. Current work assistance ranges from 1 to 5 percent of work hours, with reported time savings around 1.4 percent of total hours. Adoption patterns mirror PC adoption by education and occupation demographics.
